review_items: Depth: SIA gives 17.5" overall; sketch shows a 6" flange and 12" stems (18"). Model uses 17.5" overall with the 6" flange (11.5" stems).

SIA deck element (DT top flange): transverse flexure cracks up to 0.06" wide (CS3), at 9" spacing within 3-4 ft of the ends (top surface) and at 4-6 ft spacing throughout (underside). Confirm these are not load-induced girder distress before applying the BRM 1.4(O) shear waiver and BRM 1.7.2(A).

Joint grout spalled/missing up to 1" deep with transverse cracks, exposed rebar at the 2nd and 3rd joints from the west, and leakage at all joints (CS2/CS3). Consider whether load sharing between units is still adequate for the distribution factors used.
Girders B and I webs at Abutment 1: short, insignificant-width longitudinal cracks with rust staining (CS3).
Bridge rail: new (2) TS5x5 rails on (4) steel posts per side, with the old 3" pipe rail still in place behind it. Both are included in the rail dead load.

bridge._span: CL brg to CL brg 32'-9" (sketch); SIA max span 32.8 ft
review_items: Girder A (exterior, west face): 14 ft long x 0.035" arching crack from vehicular impact up to the top fillet near midspan, with a 0.016" crack below it (CS3). The 2023 engineering-judgment summary applied a flexural condition factor of 0.85 to Girder A; this back-calculated rating applies none. Decide whether to reduce Girder A's capacity in BrR.

Girders at Abutment 1: insignificant to wide longitudinal cracks up to 20" long with rust staining and delamination (CS3); spalls with exposed rebar in top flanges and stem ends at Abutment 1. Possible strand corrosion near the bearings.
Unit layout from the sketch: 5 interior units 8'-0" wide and 2 exterior units 5'-0" wide. Stem spacing within units (48" interior, 36" exterior) is scaled from the sketch.

Sidewalks (5'-0" each side, 10" assumed thickness) treated as mountable per the two-model rule: rated with trucks curb-to-curb plus 60 psf pedestrian load, and with trucks on the sidewalk without pedestrian load. Two BrR models needed.
Utilities: (4) 4 1/2" steel pipes and (1) 4 1/2" PVC pipe on the west side, taken empty. Confirm contents.
Superstructure NBI = 5, the minimum for the BRM 1.4(O) shear waiver.

bridge._span: Two simple spans, 66'-0" CL brg to CL pier each (sketch); deck has a compression joint over Pier 2, so spans are rated as identical simple spans
review_items: 2023 SIA: CS4 deck spall over Pier 2 (42" x 18" x 4" deep, exposed corroded rebar) with an Essential Repair Letter sent to the owner 11/16/2023. 2025 SIA notes asphalt patches failing. Confirm repair status; the deck is not rated here.

Girder bottoms at Pier 2 (and 2A at Abutment 3): longitudinal cracks up to 0.125" with delamination, some with rust staining (CS3), plus spalls with exposed corroded rebar in 1P, 2C and 2R. Possible strand corrosion near the bearings; shear is waived per BRM 1.4(O) but end-region strand condition should be considered.
Span taken as 66'-0" (CL abutment bearing to CL pier); the actual bearing-to-bearing span is slightly shorter, so this is slightly conservative.
15 degree skew: no LFD moment reduction applied (SSHB). Enter the skew in BrR.

Sidewalks (5'-0" plus 12" rail edge each side) treated as mountable per the two-model rule: rated with trucks curb-to-curb plus 60 psf pedestrian load, and with trucks on the sidewalk without pedestrian load. Two BrR models needed.
Stem spacing within units 4'-7 1/2" and unit spacing 6'-10 1/2" from the sketch; precast depth 45" (38" stem + 7" flange) matches the CDOT 1982 double-tee standard for 66 ft spans.
Midspan 8" x 30" concrete diaphragms on skew included as a 1.72 kip point load per girder (DC1).
bridge.assumption_flag: Sidewalk thickness, rail weight, deck f'c and diaphragm weight are assumed; confirm before the BrR run.

bridge._span: CL brg to CL brg 60'-0" (sketch); SIA max span 60 ft
review_items: GIRDER DEPTH UNKNOWN: no sketch, SIA or prior rating gives it. Assumed 45" overall including the 2" precast flange and 5.5" deck (37.5" stems + 2" flange + 5.5" deck), matching the CDOT double-tee standard section for 60-66 ft spans. Field-measure before the BrR run; depth sets the strand count and force but has little effect on the legal-load ratings.

Girders: 0.02" fillet cracks with efflorescence full length (CS3); Girder J at Abutment 2, 0.25" longitudinal crack with rust stains and delamination; Girder A at Abutment 1, horizontal web crack up to 0.05" with rust staining and delamination (2025). Possible strand corrosion at the exterior girders near the bearings.

Substructure: progressive settlement at the north end of both abutments (Abutment 1 crack 0.09" in 2011 to 1.25" in 2023) and exposed footings. Not part of this superstructure rating; flag to the owner.
40 degree skew: no LFD moment reduction applied (SSHB). Enter the skew in BrR.
Deck f'c assumed 3.0 ksi for 1973 construction; the SIA lists 1992 reconstruction, so the deck may be newer (4.5 ksi). Higher deck f'c slightly increases capacity.
Rail dead load includes the 14" concrete curb under the posts (assumed 10" high).
bridge.assumption_flag: Girder depth is assumed (45" overall) and is the most important item to field-verify. Stem widths, deck f'c and curb height are also assumed.
